title: App Discovery: Content Requirements Policy
body:
App Discovery Content Requirements

App Discovery gives users multiple ways to find and install your app across Discord, such as App Directory and App Launcher. In order for your Application to be eligible for discovery, certain content requirements must be met:

  • You and your application must continue to comply with Discord’s Terms of Service, Discord Community Guidelines, Discord Developer Terms of Service, and Discord Developer Policy.
  • Your application must have a connected and publicly available Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
  • Your Application’s content must not contain any adult content. Adult content includes, but is not limited to, content and discussion related to:
    • Sexually explicit material such as pornography or sexually explicit text
    • Violent content
    • Illegal, dangerous, and regulated goods such as firearms, tactical gear, alcohol, or drug use
    • Gambling-adjacent or addictive behavior
  • Your Application's name, description, and commands must not contain any IP-violating content.

Enabling Discovery

After you and your application meet the eligibility requirements for discovery and your application is verified, you can enable discovery for your application in the Discord Developer Portal. To enable discoverability, navigate to the Discovery tab within the Developer Portal. Then, at the bottom of the Discovery Status tab, click on the “Enable Discovery” button.

If you have additional questions about App Discovery, reach out to our developer support team here.
